summary: Veea Inc. filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, reporting that director Helder Antunes resigned from the board effective October 8, 2026, while remaining Executive Vice President and Chief Revenue Officer; the company stated the resignation was not due to any disagreement. Separately, director Alan Black was appointed to the Compensation Committee, and the board unanimously reduced its size to five members. No financial terms, advisor, premium, or transaction mechanics were disclosed. This is a routine board-composition and committee-appointment disclosure, not a forced or abrupt executive departure, so no special-situation or risk-arb angle applies; watch for any subsequent management changes.
